data.name: Menu.Language
data.comment: 助记符已占用一对括号，故此处改用冒号，避免出现「语言(L)(简体中文)」的双括号。

data.name: Toolbar.Resume
data.comment: 显示暂停期间的工具栏按钮文字（P1-40）。按钮在本键与 Toolbar.Pause 之间切换，让「再点一下就能恢复」变得显然。

data.name: Dialog.Export.Title
data.comment: 导出选项对话框的标题。「导出」按钮与「停止记录」之后都会打开它。

data.name: Dialog.Export.Format
data.comment: 刻意叫「文件类型」而不是「格式」—— .tsv 与 .txt 内容完全相同（制表符分隔、一帧一行），差别只有扩展名。叫「格式」会让人以为数据本身不一样。

data.name: Enum.ExportFormat.Tsv
data.comment: ⚠️ 不要加「.csv」这个选项：名为 .csv 而内容是制表符分隔的文件，Excel 双击打开会把整行塞进一列 —— 而 csv 的主要受众正是要拖进 Excel 的人。见 01-spec 6.4。

data.name: Toolbar.ShowChannel
data.comment: 刻意与 Log.Column.Channel 用同一个词，让「勾选框 ↔ 它控制的那一列」一眼对应。

data.name: Toolbar.ShowSent
data.comment: Send-area checkbox, terminal sessions only: shows/hides locally sent rows (T-05, spec 4.12). It hides ROWS, not a column — do not word it as a column. ⚠️ Deliberately longer than the English "Sent" (user decision 2026-08-02): in Chinese the Send button one row below reads 发送 too, so a bare 发送 put the SAME word twice in one panel meaning two different things — a display toggle and "put bytes on the wire". English has no such clash (Sent is not Send), so it stayed short. ⚠️ The note here used to say "keep it as short as 通道/Δms" — that reason expired on 2026-08-02: those two moved into the terminal "display settings" flyout (spec 6.7 甲) while this one moved into the send area. They are no longer side by side.

data.name: Channel.AliasPlaceholder
data.comment: {0} = 端口名，如「COM6 的别名」。⚠️ 2026-08-01 取代原先的 Channel.AliasAPlaceholder / AliasBPlaceholder（「通道 A 别名」）—— 交换 A/B 删除后 A/B 两个字母整体退场，见 01-spec 4.13。

data.name: Channel.TimestampNote
data.value: 时间戳为软件级打点，受 USB 轮询与系统调度影响，不等同于硬件级微秒时间戳。

data.name: Channel.PortWithAlias
data.comment: {0} = 端口名，{1} = 用户填的别名。仅在用户改过名之后才用；改名前只显示端口名，因为别名默认就等于端口名，否则会出现 COM6「COM6」这种自我重复。

data.name: Send.DisabledWarning
data.value: 监听模式下发送已禁用。向通道写入会把数据真实注入总线。

data.name: Send.FormatAscii
data.comment: Not translated on purpose: protocol abbreviation, 03-conventions 2.7.

data.name: Send.FormatHex
data.comment: Not translated. User decided 2026-08-02; must match Enum.DisplayFormat.Hex, which changed from "十六进制" to HEX in the same round (P2-23).

data.name: Send.History
data.comment: PlaceholderText of the send-history dropdown (T-03a). ⚠️ This is the dropdown's permanent resting text, not a transient hint: SelectedHistoryEntry always resets itself to null (SendPanelViewModel.OnSelectedHistoryEntryChanged), so the placeholder is never replaced by a selection. That is why it works as the control's label and why no separate label sits next to it — a label plus this placeholder would put the same word on screen twice, side by side (user decision 2026-08-02). ⚠️ It must therefore keep NAMING the content ("历史指令"), not read like an instruction ("选择…"): with an empty-looking box the user cannot tell "no history yet" from "nothing picked". English stays the shorter "History" by the same decision.

data.name: Session.CloseWhileRecording.Message
data.value: 关闭该会话会停止记录。已记录的数据留在数据库里，但不会写出导出文件 —— 需要导出文件的话，请先取消并点「停止记录」。

data.name: Send.HistoryClear.Message
data.value: 将删除全部 {0} 条已保存的指令，含列表中未显示的部分。此操作无法撤销。

data.name: Send.HistoryClear.Failed
data.value: 历史未能删除，数据仍保存在磁盘上。

data.name: Send.HistoryRemoveTip
data.value: 从保存的历史中删除这一条

data.name: Dialog.NewSession.TerminalDesc
data.value: 打开一个串口，收发数据、调试设备。

data.name: Dialog.NewSession.MonitorDesc
data.value: 同时打开两个串口，旁路监听双向通讯，不干扰原有链路。
data.comment: ⚠️ 这是用户读到的第一段关于监听的说明：2026-08-03 起卡片也出现在空状态上，而原先在那里的那段散文（Empty.Description）已删除 —— 它用文字解释同一件事，两处文案此前必须靠人保持不矛盾。⚠️ 不得再写「diSerial 会提示创建监听会话」这类措辞：插入提示（原 M-02）已于 2026-07-29 移除，插上设备本身不会有任何反应，用户从「新建会话」按钮开始。那句错的承诺中英两份都发布过，直到 1a 用人眼读出来才发现（P1-27）；现在由 ResourceWordingTests.BannedPhrases 直接让构建失败。此处不提任何具体硬件 —— 01-spec 原则 2 规定产品名只允许出现在「关于」。

data.name: Dialog.NewSession.MonitorRequires
data.comment: 监听对任意两个端口成立：双通道适配器、两根独立 USB 线、或 diDatatracker。措辞保持通用。

data.name: Session.Monitor.Status
data.comment: {0}/{2} 是两路通道的描述，由 Channel.PortWithAlias 拼好后传进来（改名前只有端口名）。{1}/{3} 是各自的接收字节数，紧跟在它那一路后面。{4}=串口参数，{5}=状态，{6}=帧数。⚠️ 2026-08-01 起不再有 A:/B:/A↓/B↓ —— 交换 A/B 删除后那两个字母不指向任何东西，见 01-spec 4.13。

data.name: State.DisplayPaused
data.comment: {0} = 连接状态（已连接 / 监听中 / …）。显示暂停期间出现在状态栏（P1-40）。⚠️ 它是**追加**在实时状态后面而不是替换掉它 —— 暂停期间采集、计数、记录全都照常（规格 4.2a），把「监听中」换成「已暂停」会把事实说反。

data.name: State.Recording
data.comment: Appended, never a replacement.

data.name: Decoder.Modbus.IllegalDataAddress
data.comment: Modbus RTU 异常码 02。数字要保留，工程师是按编号查的。

data.name: ErrorKind.Unknown
data.value: 操作失败。详细原因请查看日志文件。

data.name: ErrorKind.PortNotFound
data.value: 找不到这个串口。可能已被拔出，或端口名不对。

data.name: ErrorKind.AccessDenied
data.value: 端口正被其他程序占用，或当前账户没有打开它的权限。

data.name: ErrorKind.DeviceRemoved
data.value: 设备已断开。重新插好后再连接一次。

data.name: ErrorKind.Timeout
data.value: 端口在规定时间内没有响应。

data.name: ErrorKind.InvalidInput
data.value: 待发送的内容无法解析。HEX 模式下请成对使用 0-9 / A-F，例如：01 03 00 00。

data.name: ErrorKind.IntervalTooSmall
data.value: 定时发送的间隔太短。最小允许 20 ms；间隔未被改动。
data.comment: Must say the value was NOT changed — refuse, never clamp.

data.name: ErrorKind.NothingToSend
data.value: 没有可发送的内容。请输入要重复发送的内容，或从历史指令里选一条。
data.comment: P2-50 (2). Must name a way forward: a successful send empties the box, so this is the end of a normal workflow, not a corner case.

data.name: ErrorKind.LineError
data.value: 串口线路报告了错误（校验错、帧错或溢出）。收到的数据可能不正确 —— 请核对波特率、校验位与停止位是否与设备一致。

data.name: ErrorKind.RecordingFailed
data.value: 记录已停止：帧写入失败。请检查磁盘剩余空间，以及记录数据库是否可写。

data.name: Dialog.NewSession.OpenFailed.Terminal
data.value: 无法打开 {0}：{1}请检查后重试。
data.comment: 在新建会话对话框内显示。对话框保持打开，用户改个端口直接重试。{0} 端口名，{1} 由 ErrorKind.* 映射出的分类原因。底层异常原文只进日志，不得写进这里。⚠️ {1} 后面**刻意不加句号** —— 七条 ErrorKind.* 文案全部自带句号结尾，再加就成了「权限。。」。2026-07-30 实测撞过。

data.name: Dialog.NewSession.OpenFailed.Monitor
data.value: 监听会话需要同时打开 2 个串口。通道 {0}（{1}）无法打开：{2}请检查后重试。
data.comment: 监听版本。{0} 通道字母 A 或 B，{1} 端口名，{2} 分类原因。必须说清是哪一路 —— 不说的话用户不知道该改哪个下拉框。⚠️ 端口是顺序打开的，所以「两个都失败」表现为通道 A（B 根本没被尝试过）。⚠️ 用「监听」不用「监控」：功能名按 01-spec 原则 2 定为「串口监听」。

data.name: Enum.DisplayFormat.Hex
data.comment: Was "十六进制" until 2026-08-02. Kept untranslated so the display dropdown and the send area's HEX radio button read the same on one screen (P2-23), and to match the "do not translate protocol abbreviations" rule in 03-conventions 2.7 — which this entry used to contradict.

data.name: Enum.DisplayFormat.HexAndAscii
data.comment: See Enum.DisplayFormat.Hex.

data.name: Enum.SerialParity.None
data.comment: ⛔ Deliberately NOT translated -- user decision 2026-08-05 (P2-68, option B). The parity dropdown is kept wholly English because Mark and Space have no settled Chinese rendering; translating three of five was the state this decision replaced. ⚠️ Do not "fix" this back to 无 on its own -- the criterion is that the five values agree with each other, so any change here is a change to all five. ⭐ 2026-08-07 UPDATE -- a SECOND criterion now also holds, and it points the same way: flow control and line ending were changed from 无 to None on that date, so all four serial-parameter dropdowns are wholly English. Translating parity now would break agreement BETWEEN controls as well as leave Mark/Space untranslatable. ⚠️ The earlier note above said this dropdown was the odd one out; it no longer is -- it was the one the others were brought into line WITH.

data.name: Enum.SerialParity.Odd
data.comment: Kept English with the rest of the parity dropdown -- see Enum.SerialParity.None.

data.name: Enum.SerialParity.Even
data.comment: Kept English with the rest of the parity dropdown -- see Enum.SerialParity.None.

data.name: Enum.SerialFlowControl.None
data.comment: ⛔ Deliberately NOT translated -- user decision 2026-08-07. It read 无 until then, which made the SAME WORD render differently in two adjacent dropdowns: parity showed None (P2-68, option B) while flow control one row below showed 无. ⭐ The rule this settles: SERIAL PARAMETER enums stay English in every language; UI PROSE is translated. See spec 4.x "串口参数类枚举不译" for the boundary. ⚠️ This REVERSES the "译词、不译标识符" reasoning recorded in P2-68 (无 is a word, so that rule said translate it). The user overrode it on audience grounds -- engineers read these five terms in English -- which is information that rule never weighed. Do not re-argue it without new information.

data.name: Enum.LineEnding.None
data.comment: ⛔ Deliberately NOT translated -- same 2026-08-07 decision as Enum.SerialFlowControl.None; read that comment for the rule and its cost. This dropdown is now wholly English (None / CR / LF / CRLF), matching parity and flow control.
